bigdaddyhurt1177: Quite daring. Going outside with your sexbot. Ya got some balls on ya I must say.
You: T-thanks, but what are you doing here?!
bigdaddyhurt1177: It’s my gallery of course! I started losing faith that you will ever visit this place. It’s close to your home so I thought it was just a matter of time.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Don’t worry, I just wanted to say hi to a fellow connoisseur, that’s all.
bigdaddyhurt1177: But I would never have thought that you would want to do it in public. Quite daring.
You: N-No, we are not having sex in public, are you mad?!
bigdaddyhurt1177: Oh? Then I’m puzzled as to why you would come here with her.
You: W-well, it’s complicated.
bigdaddyhurt1177: What a shame! 
bigdaddyhurt1177: Excuse me now, I need to attend to other guests. Have fun little one.
